meta.note: Public profile enrichment and visual-development briefs for the central adult cast.

profiles.portraitAlt: Meredith Bell in a formal charcoal jacket, looking directly at the camera.
profiles.summary: Co-founded DSN after tracing the same impossible transmission through four unrelated professional networks. Publicly exacting, privately overinvolved in every department.
profiles.portraitBrief: American woman, 58, composed investigative journalist, silver-threaded dark bob, direct brown eyes, tailored charcoal jacket, restrained authority, contemporary association portrait.

profiles.portraitAlt: Archived portrait of Sameer Dastur in a worn blazer and dark knit.
profiles.summary: Built DSN’s witness-care standards and resigned after the 2019 internal review. His archived guidance remains mandatory reading.
profiles.portraitBrief: British-Indian man, 62, warm but guarded face, salt-and-pepper hair and close beard, soft knit under an old blazer, natural window light.

profiles.portraitAlt: Camille Arsenault in field clothing beside an expedition vehicle.
profiles.summary: Led the 2019 expedition after documenting a town-shaped omission across unrelated oral traditions. Contact was lost with the full team.
profiles.portraitBrief: French-Canadian person, 55, weathered expressive face, short greying curls, practical wool field layers, photographed outdoors before an expedition.

profiles.portraitAlt: Preserved early-2000s credential photograph of Imani Okafor in a rescue jacket.
profiles.summary: Established DSN’s first field-safety protocols. Her memorial profile remains visible for training and archival purposes.
profiles.portraitBrief: Nigerian-American woman, search-and-rescue commander, athletic build, focused dark eyes, natural hair pulled back, early-2000s rescue jacket, scanned credential photograph.

profiles.summary: Field lead for the Wren’s End expedition and a meticulous safety officer known for ending deployments early when conditions changed.
profiles.portraitBrief: Nigerian-American woman, 41, sturdy athletic build, braided hair secured for fieldwork, amber rescue shell, alert and reassuring expression.

profiles.summary: Designed portable isolation rigs used across DSN audio reviews. Their final expedition upload contains eight distinct voices.
profiles.portraitBrief: Japanese nonbinary adult, 34, lean build, straight black undercut, round glasses, layered utility vest, headphones resting at the neck.

profiles.summary: No public biography is available for this account.
profiles.portraitBrief: Damaged map thumbnail occupying the portrait field; no face is visible.

profiles.summary: Assessed unsafe sites before field entry and maintained a public thread devoted to buildings with impossible load paths.
profiles.portraitBrief: Lebanese-French woman, 51, angular face, dark wavy hair streaked with grey, safety glasses raised on her head, work jacket over practical clothing.

profiles.summary: Produced long-form case documentaries and repeatedly published material before review. Account retained under evidence-preservation policy.
profiles.portraitBrief: British man, 38, tired pale face, unruly brown hair, light stubble, weatherproof jacket, compact camera strap crossing his chest.

profiles.summary: Built DSN’s first resilient evidence mirror and volunteered to maintain communications during the 2019 expedition.
profiles.portraitBrief: Filipino woman, 31, compact build, chin-length black hair, sharp attentive eyes, field hoodie under a technical vest, old access card clipped at the collar.

profiles.summary: Oversees witness protection, staff welfare, and internal review. Known for answering questions with more precise questions.
profiles.portraitBrief: British-American woman, 52, controlled posture, ash-brown hair in a low twist, fine expression lines, dark high-collared blouse and tailored coat.

profiles.summary: Coordinates international deployments and personally reviews every unresolved extraction. Dislikes the phrase acceptable losses.
profiles.portraitBrief: Nigerian-American man, 49, broad sturdy build, close-cropped hair, short beard, visible fatigue, association field jacket with worn rescue patches.

profiles.summary: Maintains the chain of custody for DSN’s physical and digital records. Can identify six generations of forged case forms by staple placement.
profiles.portraitBrief: Polish woman, 39, pale olive complexion, long dark-blonde braid, rectangular glasses, crisp shirt under a practical cardigan, red archival pencil in hand.

profiles.summary: Runs the public network, trains moderators, and has locked the same cursed-doll thread seventeen times.
profiles.portraitBrief: Brazilian man, 44, warm brown skin, shaved head, neat moustache, expressive tired eyes, rolled sleeves, headset resting beside one ear.

profiles.summary: Responsible for keeping the network useful during ordinary failures and documenting failures that are not ordinary.
profiles.portraitBrief: South Korean man, 36, slim build, short black hair, understated glasses, black technical overshirt, neutral studio portrait with a sleepless expression.

profiles.summary: Checks geographic claims and quietly maintains a private list of locations that disappear between map revisions.
profiles.portraitBrief: Indonesian woman, 29, medium-brown skin, long black hair tied low, oval glasses, practical rust-red overshirt, map-grid light reflected across her face.

profiles.summary: Finds interface failures before release and keeps finding a user identifier the production database insists does not exist.
profiles.portraitBrief: Battered handheld signal tester covered in tiny repair labels, photographed against a violet anti-static mat.

profiles.summary: Joined after documenting a repeated emergency exit that led somewhere different on every inspection.
profiles.portraitBrief: Somali-British woman, 32, deep brown skin, practical charcoal hijab, focused dark eyes, amber-tabbed field vest, compact medical pouch at the shoulder.

profiles.summary: Tracks duplicate accounts and deleted discussion chains. Maintains that resurrecting old threads is research when she does it.
profiles.portraitBrief: Brazilian woman, 27, tan skin, dense dark curls with one bleached streak, nose ring, oversized knit and red staff lanyard, amused suspicious expression.

profiles.summary: Translates archived discussions and remembers which argument produced every current moderation rule.
profiles.portraitBrief: Ghanaian-British woman, 35, dark skin, long microbraids gathered over one shoulder, moss-green cardigan, archive notes visible behind her.

profiles.summary: Tests extraordinary claims with controlled recreations and increasingly specific requests not to be tagged in doll videos.
profiles.portraitBrief: Chilean man, 46, olive skin, thick dark hair greying at the temples, close beard, pale blue shirt and laboratory cardigan, skeptical but kind expression.

profiles.summary: Leads difficult follow-up entries and removes volunteers who mistake livestream enthusiasm for field competence.
profiles.portraitBrief: Irish woman, 40, freckled weathered face, cropped copper hair, strong compact build, dark rescue jacket with amber threshold insignia.

profiles.summary: Publishes brutally practical equipment reviews and moderates the recurring thread about expensive things members broke.
profiles.portraitBrief: Soot-marked yellow multimeter wearing two adhesive googly eyes beside a cup of screws.

profiles.summary: Energetic documentarian with excellent cameras, terrible collaborators, and a statistically improbable number of staged submissions sent to her inbox.
profiles.portraitBrief: Moroccan-French woman, 25, warm olive skin, shoulder-length dark curls, winged eyeliner, oversized red windbreaker, candid night photograph lit by a camera monitor.

profiles.summary: Shares garden photographs, local weather notes, and patient corrections about a town that cannot be located on any current map.
profiles.portraitBrief: Hungarian-New Zealander woman, 73, softly lined face, short white hair, knitted cardigan, gentle smile, photographed on a foggy cottage porch among roses.
